response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10;
